main_integration_review.scope: Main independently checked every recorded term and keyword page location within actual chapter regions, visually reviewed mixed-page boundaries, spot-checked typography, and reviewed every cue and reuse target. Draft-pending notes below are historical and superseded by this section. AI review, not clinical, legal, human-expert, empirical recall or image validation.
main_integration_review.normalizations: Joined line-wrap hyphens and title punctuation; omitted trademark glyph in Shiley. Explicit shared-word expansions: patient and family wishes; spiritual, psychosocial, and educational support; recovery of organs for transplantation; Disrupted or Distorted airway. Not all are contiguous quotations.

title: Noninvasive Airway Management and Supraglottic Airways

source.verification: Author computed SHA256, inspected all seven full-page rasters, enumerated font spans and annotations on PDF31-37, checked lexical locations within clipped ownership regions. Main independent draft review pending; no clinical or empirical validation.

scope: 98 offline vocabulary trials: 51 newly recorded candidates, 28 reuses, 19 holds after main draft feedback. Includes five tables, meaningful bold/italic/headings and illustrated device labels. Editorial selection, not exhaustive all concepts or every body word. No clinical teaching, facts, narration or prompts.

source_wording_notes.page ownership: PDF37 Table29A-1 is not Chapter28. All PDF37 source locations are left-column above REFERENCES, independently inspected by author.
source_wording_notes.normalization: Case, whitespace, nonbreaking spaces, trademark glyphs and line-wrap hyphens normalized. Singular/plural morphology explicitly normalized for lexical targets; source variants remain in keyword_screen.aliases.
source_wording_notes.Type 1 respiratory failure: Bold Type 1 respiratory fail- / ure joined across a right-column line break PDF31; Type 2 respiratory failure wraps too.
source_wording_notes.tonsils / adenoids: Large tonsils / Large adenoids table labels reduced to lexical nouns, no size criterion retained.
source_wording_notes.laryngitis / respiratory syncytial virus: Separate lexical names extracted from slash-and-wrap cell Laryngitis/respiratory syncytial virus; no equality or causal claim.
source_wording_notes.hematoma / masses: Slash cell Hematoma/masses split into two vocabulary trials; Neck masses separately tried. Not synonyms.
source_wording_notes.foreign body / hemorrhage: Slash-separated cell split without causal interpretation.
source_wording_notes.disrupted airway: Expanded shared headword from Disrupted or Distorted airway; not claimed contiguous in that table. Distorted airway is contiguous.
source_wording_notes.stiff lungs / chest wall / cervical spin: Selected lexical headwords from Stiff lungs or chest wall / Stiff lungs or cervical spine. No prediction rule retained.
source_wording_notes.nasal cannulae: Exact Table28-3 plural, distinguished from nasopharyngeal/nasal airway.
source_wording_notes.oropharyngeal / nasopharyngeal: Table plural normalized to singular; Oral and Nasal parenthetical synonyms verified in bold device subheads PDF32 and33, not silently equated with cannulae.
source_wording_notes.abbreviations: BVM, CPAP, BiPAP, NIPPV expanded in Table28-2/4. SGA(s), LMA and King LT are source aliases. Expansion is name metadata, not proof that their broad shared cue distinguishes modes/devices.
source_wording_notes.source caption: Figure28-5 caption says Esophageal airways; recorded only as caption wording, not a new anatomical classification claim. Its named device labels receive trials.
source_wording_notes.italic modes: PDF34 expiratory positive airway pressure and positive end-expiratory pressure are MinionPro-It 9pt; inspiratory positive airway pressure supplementary trial is regular, not falsely called italic.
source_wording_notes.holds: Historical sound-attempt rejections for cannula, syringe and forceps remain preserved despite newly accepted literal device-category/family candidates. Catheter, angioedema and pneumonia remain holds. Chapter21 inflammatory-responses hold is not resolved by reuse of Chapter26's flame ingredient.
source_wording_notes.Shiley: Source appends private-use trademark glyph U+F8E8 after Shiley in caption/body; explicitly stripped along with trademark glyphs in device names. Selected lexical device name is not claimed glyph-exact.

keyword_screen.method: Offline PyMuPDF 1.27.2.3 dict span/font/size/coordinate inspection on all seven pages, bounded by actual title/reference blocks and column ownership. Bold/Semibold/Black names and bold flag16 inspected; meaningful regular-font table/device labels and italic mode-name phrases separately identified. All seven full-page source rasters visually inspected. Tried short lexical headwords after separating emphasized recommendations from actions/numbers. No arbitrary term target and no exhaustive key-concept census claimed.
keyword_screen.typography_limits: Zero annotations does not rule out flattened or publisher highlighting. Raster screen found publisher heading colors, table shading and emphasis; these are not PDF highlight annotations. Typography is not a salience ranking or assurance that every meaningful body word was captured.
